title: YearGlass
description: A living persistent sanctuary framed within a cozy evening workspace. Nurture an evolving micro-ecosystem, observe procedural growth, and unwind with responsive atmosphere.
summary: A persistent living sanctuary combining time, simulation, and responsive atmosphere into a calm desktop companion.
returnValue: A calm long-term companion. Day 1: welcome + subtle growth. Week 1: milestone memory + creature patterns. Longer: anniversary reflection + preserved photos + grown sanctuary.
updatedOverview: YearGlass is a persistent living sanctuary framed within a cozy evening workspace. Nurture an evolving micro-ecosystem, observe procedural plant growth through dynamic day/night cycles, and unwind with an interactive, focus-driven environment.
expectations: Living Ecosystem & Companion: Nurture Pip the ladybug and watch your terrarium respond to gentle daily care.
Dynamic Lighting & Shaders: Real-time day/night shifts, realistic ambient lamp glow, and multi-layered WebGL depth effects.
Procedural Soundscape: Zero-loop ambient Web Audio that gently swells and reacts as you interact with the room.
Focus Zoom & Journal: Tap to transition directly into close-up terrarium focus mode, track memory logs, and record field notes.
Performance Optimized: Low-power idle engine throttling designed to run quietly in the background without draining battery.
